notes:
Quick summary: Fathom Connect is a commerce platform provider (marketplace + payments). Primary pain: agents waste time opening multiple systems to refund/adjust orders and escalate; high volume during promotions -> big latency spikes. They want an agent-assist layer that can: 1) summarize ticket thread, 2) execute tool-calls (create/update Zendesk/SF tickets, call refund API on their payment gateway, open fraud/escalation workflows), 3) offer safe fallbacks when downstream APIs rate-limit or time out.

Customer quotes / call snippets:
- "If we could remove the 3-click refund flow we save ~12s per ticket on average and reduce mistakes" (ops lead)
- "Need tight audit trail for any automated refund; finance will not accept manual-only logs" (VP Ops)

Desired SLA/targets: 
- P95 ticket update latency <= 350ms for simple metadata changes; end-to-end tool-call (refund) <= 1.2s under normal load, and bounded (fail-fast + queue) under spikes.
- Throughput target: sustained 150 reqs/sec with 800+ burst capacity during promos.

Model + routing preferences: prefer open models they can pin; will accept Redwood-verified quantized variants. Want routing policy that sends low-confidence calls to canary human review or a sandbox.

Security/compliance notes: PCI scope for refund APIs must be reduced via tokenized calls and KMS. Must support SSO for agents and immutable audit logs for every tool-call. EU merchant data must stay in eu-west region.

Technical constraints:
- Primary ticket system: Zendesk, secondary: Salesforce Service Cloud for enterprise customers.
- Refund gateway: internal payments API (REST) behind API gateway with API keys + HMAC.
- Existing middleware: Node.js orchestration (kafka event bus). POC should include a small connector service.

POC ask / success criteria:
- Implement 1) ticket summarization + suggested actions, 2) tool-call to create refund (sandbox) and update ticket status, 3) spike test at 1.5x expected peak with graceful degradation.
- Logs accessible from Redwood Console; token-level cost breakdown to show delta vs naive approach.
- Security sign-off from their InfoSec (SOC2 evidence + KMS integration design).
